darling.tip: darling 是对亲人的昵称，口语常用。

hold.tip: hold 是拿着、抱住；hold on 是别挂断。

moment.tip: a moment 是一会儿；at the moment 是此刻。

voice.tip: voice 指人的嗓音，sound 泛指声音。

kick.en: He kicked the ball into the goal.
kick.tip: kick 用脚踢，过去式是 kicked。

message.en: I got a message from Beth.
message.cn: 我收到了贝丝的一条消息。

exam.tip: exam 是 examination 的缩写。

skate.en: We skate on the ice in winter.

subway.en: He takes the subway to work.
subway.tip: subway 是美式地铁，英式说 underground。

brightly.en: The stars shine brightly at night.

painting.tip: painting 是绘画作品；paint 是画的动作。

colourful.en: The market is colourful in the morning.

market.en: Mum buys fish at the market.
market.tip: market 市场；at the market 在市场。

side.en: Walk on this side of the road.
side.tip: side 边、侧；side by side 是并排。

explain.cn: 你能解释一下这个词吗？
explain.tip: explain sth to sb = 向某人解释某事。

drive.en: My father drives me to school.
drive.tip: drive sb to = 开车送某人去；过去式 drove。

passenger.en: The passenger got off the bus.
passenger.tip: passenger 乘客，注意有两个 s。

bright.en: The room is bright in the morning.
bright.tip: bright 明亮的，也指「聪明的」。

Nairobi.en: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
Nairobi.cn: 内罗毕是肯尼亚的首都。
Nairobi.tip: Nairobi 内罗毕，肯尼亚的首都。

east.en: The sun rises in the east.
east.tip: in the east 在东方，east 前面要加 the。

dry.en: The weather is dry in winter.

north.en: Birds fly to the north in spring.
north.tip: in the north of = 在……的北部。

lightning.tip: lightning 闪电，不可数；lighten 是变亮。

lucky.en: You are lucky to have such friends.
lucky.cn: 你有这样的朋友真幸运。

affect.cn: 天气会影响我们的心情。
affect.tip: affect 是动词「影响」；effect 才是名词。

south.en: It is warmer in the south.

rock.en: The rock is too heavy to move.
rock.cn: 这块岩石太重了搬不动。

heavily.tip: rain heavily 才是雨下得大，不说 rain big。

temperature.tip: temperature 温度；问气温说 What's the temperature?

rest.tip: rest 是休息；the rest 是「剩下的部分」。

glad.en: I am glad to see you.
glad.tip: be glad to do = 很高兴做某事。

thought.tip: thought 既是 think 的过去式，也是名词「想法」。

ground.en: The ground is wet after the rain.
ground.tip: ground 地面；on the ground 在地上。

tiring.tip: tiring 令人疲倦的；tired 是人自己感到累。

wet.tip: wet 湿的；wet through 是湿透。

fog.en: The fog is thick this morning.
fog.tip: fog 雾，不可数；thick fog 是大雾。

John.tip: John 约翰，人名首字母大写。

shout.tip: shout at sb = 冲某人大喊。

Anna.tip: Anna 安娜，人名首字母大写。

wind.tip: wind 风，不可数；windy 是形容词。

wastewater.en: The factory cleans its wastewater first.
wastewater.cn: 这家工厂先把废水处理干净。

museum.en: We visited a science museum today.
museum.cn: 我们今天参观了科学博物馆。

waste.en: Don't waste water in the bathroom.
waste.tip: waste 浪费；作名词是废弃物。

into.en: Pour the water into the bottle.
into.tip: into 表示往里进，in 只表示在里面。

machine.en: This machine makes paper from wood.
machine.tip: machine 机器，可数；machinery 是集合名词。

factory.en: My uncle works in a paper factory.
factory.cn: 我叔叔在一家造纸厂工作。

inside.en: It is warm inside the house.

process.en: Cleaning water is a long process.
process.cn: 净水是一个漫长的过程。

along.tip: along 沿着，后跟道路、河流。

actor.tip: actor 男演员，actress 女演员。

terrible.tip: terrible 糟糕的，比 bad 更重。

create.cn: 他们开发了一款新应用。

gun.en: The gun is not a toy.

record.cn: 请在这里录下你的声音。
record.tip: record 作动词是录音，作名词是记录。

straight.tip: go straight 直走；straight 也可指「笔直的」。

fill.tip: fill A with B = 用 B 装满 A。

tent.en: We put up a tent by the lake.
tent.cn: 我们在湖边搭了个帐篷。
tent.tip: put up a tent = 搭帐篷。

explore.en: They want to explore the old town.

branch.en: A bird sat on the branch.
branch.tip: branch 树枝，也指机构的「分部」。

entry.en: He wrote a new entry in his diary.
entry.cn: 他在日记里写了一则新的记录。
entry.tip: entry 指日记的一则，也指入口。

certainly.tip: certainly 肯定地，比 sure 更正式。

promise.en: Keep your promise, don't break it.
promise.cn: 遵守你的诺言，别违背它。
promise.tip: keep a promise 守约；break a promise 失约。

neighbour.tip: neighbour 英式拼写，美式是 neighbor。

war.tip: war 战争，可数；反义是 peace。

hunter.en: The hunter walked into the forest.

net.en: The fisherman threw the net into the sea.

silly.tip: silly 是愚蠢的，比 stupid 语气轻一点。

praise.tip: praise sb for sth = 因某事表扬某人。

decide.en: He decided to stay at home.
decide.tip: decide to do = 决定做某事。

truth.tip: truth 是名词「真相」，形容词是 true。

ugly.tip: ugly 丑陋的，反义是 beautiful。

king.en: The king lived in a big palace.
king.cn: 国王住在一座大宫殿里。

purr.en: The cat purrs when it is happy.
purr.cn: 猫高兴时会发出呼噜声。
purr.tip: purr 是猫特有的拟声动词。

search.tip: search 后直接跟地点是「搜查」；search for 才是寻找。

duckling.en: The duckling could not swim well.

die.en: The old tree died last year.
die.tip: die 是动词；dead 是形容词；death 是名词。

fisherman.en: The fisherman caught a big fish.

someone.tip: someone 用于肯定句，和 somebody 同义。

anyone.tip: anyone 用于疑问句和否定句。

set.en: The sun sets in the west.
set.tip: set 是落下；set sth free 是释放。

rich.en: The rich man gave them money.
rich.tip: rich 富有的，the rich 表示「富人」这一类人。

especially.cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
especially.tip: especially = 尤其，用来强调其中一个。

ancient.tip: ancient 古代的，反义是 modern。

vacation.en: We had a long vacation in summer.
vacation.tip: vacation 是美式假期，英式多用 holiday。

town.en: The town is quiet at night.
town.tip: town 是镇，比 city 小。

strange.en: I heard a strange sound outside.
strange.cn: 我听到外面有奇怪的声音。
strange.tip: strange 是奇怪的，也指「陌生的」。

guide.en: The guide showed us the old street.
guide.tip: guide 导游、指南；作动词是引导。

anywhere.en: You can sit anywhere you like.
anywhere.tip: anywhere 表示任何地方，多用于否定句和疑问句。

nothing.en: There is nothing in the box.
nothing.tip: nothing 本身就是否定意义，不能再加 not。

somewhere.cn: 我们去个安静的地方吧。
somewhere.tip: somewhere 用于肯定句，表示某个地方。

silk.en: This scarf is made of silk.
silk.tip: be made of silk 由丝绸制成，看得出材料用 of。

scenery.en: The scenery along the river is beautiful.
scenery.tip: scenery 风景，不可数，不能说 a scenery。

against.tip: against 靠着、反对；fight against 是抗击。

rainbow.en: A rainbow appeared after the rain.

square.en: We met in the town square.
square.tip: square 广场、正方形、平方，三个意思都考。

fight.en: The two boys fight over a toy.
fight.cn: 两个男孩为一个玩具打架。
fight.tip: fight 打架、战斗；过去式是 fought。

bored.tip: bored 是人感到无聊；boring 是事物令人无聊。

tear.cn: 眼泪顺着她的脸流下来。
tear.tip: tear 作「眼泪」常用复数 tears。

easily.tip: easy 变 y 为 i 加 ly → easily。

metro.en: The metro is faster than the bus.
metro.tip: metro 和 subway 都是地铁。

sick.en: He felt sick on the bus.
sick.cn: 他在公交车上觉得恶心。
sick.tip: sick 是生病、恶心；英式常用 ill。

Seattle.en: Seattle is a city in the USA.
Seattle.cn: 西雅图是美国的一座城市。
Seattle.tip: Seattle 西雅图，美国西北部城市。

station.en: The train station is near here.
station.tip: station 车站，也可指警察局、电台。

palace.en: The palace is open to visitors.

Russia.en: Russia is the largest country in the world.
Russia.cn: 俄罗斯是世界上最大的国家。

Moscow.en: Moscow is the capital of Russia.
Moscow.cn: 莫斯科是俄罗斯的首都。
Moscow.tip: Moscow 莫斯科，俄罗斯首都。

Vincent.tip: Vincent 文森特，人名首字母大写。

invite.en: I will invite him to my party.
invite.cn: 我会邀请他来我的聚会。
invite.tip: invite sb to sth = 邀请某人参加某事。

arrival.cn: 他的到来让我们很高兴。
arrival.tip: arrive 是动词，arrival 是名词。

pack.en: Don't forget to pack your clothes.
pack.tip: pack 打包；pack up 是收拾行李。

yet.en: He has not come back yet.
yet.tip: yet 用于否定句和疑问句，常放句尾。

treasure.en: This old photo is my treasure.
treasure.cn: 这张老照片是我的宝贝。
treasure.tip: treasure 宝物；treasure hunt 是寻宝。

borrow.tip: borrow 是借入；lend 才是借出。

plan.en: We plan to visit the museum.
plan.tip: plan to do = 打算做某事。

biscuit.en: He ate two biscuits with tea.
biscuit.cn: 他就着茶吃了两块饼干。
biscuit.tip: biscuit 英式饼干，美式叫 cookie。

movie.tip: movie 是美式电影，英式说 film。

almost.tip: almost = 几乎、差点，程度很接近。

dead.tip: dead 不只指「死的」，也指「没电了、不运行」。

note.en: He wrote a note to his teacher.
note.cn: 他给老师写了一张便条。
note.tip: note 是便条、笔记；take notes 是做笔记。

luggage.tip: luggage 不可数，不能说 luggages。

joke.cn: 他的笑话让大家都笑了。
joke.tip: joke 是笑话；play a joke on sb 是开某人玩笑。

pull.tip: pull 是拉，push 是推，门上标反了最坑人。

mm.tip: mm 是语气词，表示赞叹或同意。

journey.cn: 这段旅程花了三个小时。
journey.tip: journey 指一段较长的旅程。

nod.tip: nod 点头，过去式 nodded，要双写 d。

describe.cn: 你能描述一下那个人吗？
describe.tip: describe sth to sb = 向某人描述某物。

glue.en: Use glue to stick the paper.
glue.tip: glue 胶水，不可数；作动词是粘贴。

decorate.en: We decorate the room with flowers.
decorate.tip: decorate A with B = 用 B 装饰 A。

text.en: He sent me a text this morning.
text.cn: 他今天早上给我发了条短信。
text.tip: text 是短信、文本；作动词是发短信。

writer.en: The writer lives in a small town.
writer.cn: 这位作家住在一个小镇上。

poster.en: There is a poster on the wall.

stove.en: Don't touch the stove, it is hot.

avoid.en: Try to avoid the rush hour.
avoid.tip: avoid doing = 避免做某事，后面跟 doing。

accident.en: There was an accident on the road.
accident.tip: accident 事故；by accident 是偶然。

lighter.en: A lighter can start a fire.
lighter.tip: lighter 打火机；也是 light 的比较级。

housewife.en: The housewife cleans the house every day.
housewife.cn: 这位主妇每天打扫房子。

roll.en: The ball rolled under the bed.

luckily.tip: luckily = 幸运的是，常放句首。

check.en: Check your answers before you hand in.
check.tip: check 检查、核对；check out 是结账离开。

hold on.tip: hold on = 别挂断 / 稍等，电话里最常用。

right now.en: I am doing my homework right now.
right now.tip: right now 常放句尾，配合现在进行时。

at the moment.en: He is busy at the moment.
at the moment.tip: at the moment = 此刻，多用于现在进行时。

work on.en: I am working on a new programme.
work on.tip: work on 后面接「做的事」，不接人。

programme.cn: 这个节目是关于动物的。
programme.tip: programme 是英式拼写，美式写作 program。

ride.en: I ride my bike to school every day.
ride.tip: ride a bike = 骑车；ride 也可作名词。

call back.en: I will call you back in ten minutes.
call back.cn: 我十分钟后给你回电话。
call back.tip: call sb back = 给某人回电话，back 放最后。

could.en: Could you say that again, please?
could.tip: Could you...? 是最礼貌的请求方式。

somebody.en: Somebody is knocking at the door.
somebody.tip: somebody 用于肯定句，疑问句和否定句用 anybody。

take a message.en: Can I take a message for her?
take a message.cn: 我可以替她捎个口信吗？
take a message.tip: take a message = 替别人记下留言。

wow.en: Wow, this park is so beautiful!
wow.tip: wow 表示惊叹，后面常接感叹句。

leave a message.en: Please leave a message after the beep.
leave a message.tip: leave a message 是自己留言，take a message 是替别人记。

happen.tip: happen to sb = 某人出了什么事。

in a hurry.en: He left in a hurry this morning.
in a hurry.cn: 他今天早上匆忙离开了。
in a hurry.tip: in a hurry = 匆忙地；hurry up 才是「快点」。

around the world.en: People around the world love football.
around the world.cn: 世界各地的人都喜欢足球。
around the world.tip: around the world = 世界各地，也说 all over the world。

look forward to.en: I look forward to seeing you again.
look forward to.tip: look forward to 后面必须跟 doing，不能跟 do。

time zone.en: New York is in a different time zone.
time zone.tip: time zone = 时区，跨时区用 different time zones。

zone.en: This is a quiet zone for study.
zone.cn: 这是一个安静的学习区。
zone.tip: zone 指划出来的一块区域，如 time zone、quiet zone。

side by side.en: They walked side by side along the road.
side by side.tip: side by side = 并排，也可比喻并肩合作。

such.en: I have never seen such a big fish.
such.cn: 我从没见过这么大的鱼。
such.tip: such a + 形容词 + 名词；so 后面才直接跟形容词。

shine.en: The sun is shining brightly today.
shine.tip: shine 的现在分词是 shining，太阳发光用 shine。

central.en: The library is in the central part of the city.
central.tip: central = 中心的；Central Park 就是中央公园。

drop off.en: I will drop you off at the school gate.
drop off.tip: drop sb off = 开车顺路把某人送到某处。

drop.en: Don't drop the glass, it will break.
drop.cn: 别把玻璃杯掉了，它会碎的。
drop.tip: drop 是「掉落」；drop off 才是「送到」。

take part in.en: Many students take part in the race.
take part in.tip: take part in = 参加活动，强调亲自参与。

Beth.en: Beth is talking on the phone.
Beth.tip: 人名首字母大写，是本单元对话里的人物。

Central Park.en: We took photos in Central Park.
Central Park.cn: 我们在中央公园拍了照片。
Central Park.tip: Central Park 是纽约的中央公园，专有名词首字母都大写。

rush hour.en: The subway is crowded during rush hour.
rush hour.tip: rush hour = 上下班高峰，介词用 during。

New York.en: New York has many tall buildings.
New York.tip: New York 是美国城市纽约，两个词都大写。

Mid-Autumn Festival.en: We eat mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Mid-Autumn Festival.tip: 节日名前用 at：at the Mid-Autumn Festival。

Adam.en: Adam is waiting for a call from Beth.
Adam.tip: wait for = 等；等电话是 wait for a call。

sight.en: The Great Wall is a famous sight in China.
sight.cn: 长城是中国著名的名胜。
sight.tip: sight 指名胜、景观；see the sights 就是观光。

rush.en: Don't rush, we have enough time.
rush.cn: 别急，我们有足够的时间。
rush.tip: rush = 冲、赶；in a hurry 才是「匆忙」。别把急放错了。

sunshine.en: The children are playing in the sunshine.
sunshine.tip: sunshine 不可数，前面不加 a。

USA.en: The USA is a big country.
USA.tip: the USA 前面必须有 the，全称是 the United States of America。

stormy.en: It was a stormy night last night.
stormy.tip: storm + y → stormy，天气形容词都这么变。

stay in.en: We stayed in because of the rain.
stay in.cn: 因为下雨我们待在家里。
stay in.tip: stay in = 待在家不出门，反义是 go out。

lucky you.en: You got a free ticket? Lucky you!
lucky you.cn: 你拿到免费票了？你真幸运！
lucky you.tip: Lucky you! 是口语感叹，省掉了 You are。

rain or shine.en: We will go rain or shine.
rain or shine.cn: 不管下不下雨我们都要去。
rain or shine.tip: rain or shine = 不论晴雨，引申为「无论如何」。

freezing.en: It is freezing outside in winter.
freezing.tip: freezing 比 cold 更冷，是「冻僵」级别。

beach volleyball.en: They play beach volleyball every summer.
beach volleyball.cn: 他们每年夏天打沙滩排球。
beach volleyball.tip: 球类运动前不加 the：play beach volleyball。

magical.tip: magic 是名词，magical 是形容词「神奇的」。

feel like.en: I feel like a bird in the sky.
feel like.tip: feel like + 名词 = 感觉像；feel like doing = 想做某事。

snowy.en: The mountain is snowy all year.

through.en: The train went through a long tunnel.
through.tip: through 是从内部穿过，across 是横过表面。

peak.en: We reached the peak at noon.
peak.tip: peak = 山顶、顶峰，也指最高点。

in high spirits.en: The students are in high spirits today.
in high spirits.tip: in high spirits = 兴高采烈，反义是 in low spirits。

experience.en: It was a wonderful experience for me.
experience.cn: 这对我来说是一次美妙的经历。
experience.tip: experience 作「经验」不可数，作「经历」可数。

make progress.en: You can make progress in English.
make progress.tip: progress 不可数，不能说 a progress。

although.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
although.cn: 虽然下雨，我们还是出去了。
although.tip: although 和 but 不能同时用，这是中考高频陷阱。

still.en: He is still waiting for the bus.
still.tip: still 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

rest area.en: Let's stop at the rest area.
rest area.cn: 我们在休息区停一下吧。
rest area.tip: rest area 特指高速上的休息区。

grey.en: The sky turned grey before the storm.
grey.tip: grey 英式拼写，gray 美式，都是灰色。

at the start.en: It was sunny at the start.
at the start.tip: at the start = 开始时，对应 at the end。

seem.tip: seem + 形容词；也可说 seem to do。

because of.en: We stayed at home because of the storm.
because of.cn: 因为暴风雨我们待在家里。
because of.tip: because of 后跟名词，because 后跟一个完整句子。

sunlight.en: The sunlight came through the window.

at the top.en: There is snow at the top of the mountain.
at the top.tip: at the top of = 在……的顶部。

end.en: The story has a happy end.
end.cn: 这个故事有个圆满的结局。
end.tip: end 作名词是「结尾」；in the end = 最后。

pour.en: It is pouring outside, take an umbrella.
pour.tip: pour 本义是「倒」，下雨说 It's pouring。

Bright Peak.en: We climbed to Bright Peak in the morning.
Bright Peak.cn: 我们早上爬到了光明顶。
Bright Peak.tip: Bright Peak 是黄山光明顶，专有名词两个词都大写。

run after.en: The dog is running after a ball.
run after.tip: run after = 追赶，after 后跟被追的对象。

at the end.en: At the end, everyone was tired but happy.
at the end.tip: at the end 指时间上的末尾；in the end 指最终结果。

storm.en: A big storm is coming tonight.
storm.cn: 今晚有一场大暴风雨要来。
storm.tip: storm 可数：a storm / two storms。

Stockholm.en: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.
Stockholm.cn: 斯德哥尔摩是瑞典的首都。
Stockholm.tip: Stockholm 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典首都。

shuttlecock.en: They are playing shuttlecock in the park.
shuttlecock.tip: shuttlecock 羽毛球、毽子；play shuttlecock 是踢毽子。

forward.tip: forward = 向前；look forward to 是盼望。

snowman.en: The kids made a big snowman.
snowman.cn: 孩子们堆了一个大雪人。

sunbathe.en: They sunbathe on the beach in summer.
sunbathe.cn: 夏天他们在海滩上晒太阳。
sunbathe.tip: sun + bathe = 沐日光浴，不是「洗澡」。

remove.en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
remove.tip: remove = 移开、拿走；remove shoes 是脱鞋。

piece.en: I ate a piece of cake.
piece.tip: a piece of 后跟不可数名词：a piece of cake。

direction.en: The bird flew in the wrong direction.
direction.cn: 鸟朝错误的方向飞走了。

plant.en: My father works in a car plant.
plant.cn: 我爸爸在一家汽车厂工作。
plant.tip: plant 作名词是工厂或植物，作动词是「种植」。

meet up.en: Let's meet up at the school gate.
meet up.tip: meet up = 碰头、相聚，比 meet 更口语。

exhibition.en: We saw old paintings at the exhibition.
exhibition.cn: 我们在展览上看到了古老的画。
exhibition.tip: exhibition = 展览会；go to an exhibition 去看展。

step.en: Learning English is a step by step job.
step.cn: 学英语是一步一步的事。
step.tip: step by step = 一步一步地。

used to.en: I used to walk to school.
used to.tip: used to do = 过去常常做（现在不做了）。

realise.en: I realised my mistake at last.
realise.cn: 我终于认识到了自己的错误。
realise.tip: realise 英式，realize 美式，都是「意识到」。

germ.en: Wash your hands, germs are everywhere.
germ.tip: germ 常用复数 germs，指细菌、微生物。

go on a trip.en: We will go on a trip next week.
go on a trip.tip: go on a trip = 去旅行，trip 前面用 on。

road.en: The road is wet after the rain.
road.tip: road 是道路；on the road 表示在路上。

try on.en: Can I try on this coat?
try on.cn: 我可以试穿这件外套吗？
try on.tip: try on 的宾语是衣服；用代词时放中间：try it on。

write down.en: Please write down your name here.
write down.cn: 请在这里写下你的名字。
write down.tip: write down = 写下；用代词放中间：write it down。

basket.en: The basket is full of apples.
basket.tip: basket 篮子；a basket of = 一篮……

from ...to....en: The shop opens from nine to five.
from ...to....cn: 这家店从九点开到五点。
from ...to....tip: from ... to ... = 从……到……，时间和地点都能用。

leaf.en: A yellow leaf fell from the tree.
leaf.cn: 一片黄叶从树上落下来。
leaf.tip: leaf 的复数是 leaves，f 变 ves。

cucumber.en: I like cucumber salad in summer.
cucumber.tip: cucumber 黄瓜，可数：a cucumber 一根黄瓜。

diary.en: She writes a diary every night.
diary.tip: diary 复数 diaries；keep a diary = 记日记。

think of.en: I can't think of his name.
think of.tip: think of = 想起；think about = 考虑。

agree with.en: I agree with you on this point.
agree with.tip: agree with sb 同意某人；agree to sth 同意某事。

fresh.en: The vegetables here are very fresh.
fresh.tip: fresh 是新鲜的，也形容空气清新。

grain.cn: 大米是一种重要的谷物。
grain.tip: grain 谷物，可数；也可指「一粒」。

agree.en: We all agree to the plan.
agree.tip: agree to + 计划；agree with + 人。

finally.tip: finally = 终于，常放句首并加逗号。

someday.en: Someday I will travel around the world.
someday.cn: 总有一天我要环游世界。
someday.tip: someday 指将来的某一天，句子用将来时。

area.en: This area is famous for its old streets.

theatre.en: We watched a play at the theatre.
theatre.cn: 我们在剧院看了一场戏。
theatre.tip: theatre 英式拼写，美式是 theater。

once upon a time.en: Once upon a time, a king lived in a palace.
once upon a time.cn: 从前，有个国王住在宫殿里。
once upon a time.tip: once upon a time 是故事开头的固定说法。

long ago.en: Long ago, people had no phones.
long ago.cn: 很久以前，人们没有电话。
long ago.tip: long ago 用于一般过去时。

upon.en: The cat jumped upon the table.
upon.tip: upon 等于 on，多用于书面语和固定短语。

bite through.en: The mouse can bite through the net.
bite through.tip: bite through = 咬穿，through 表示穿透。

official.en: An official came to see the emperor.
official.tip: official 作名词是官员，作形容词是「官方的」。

emperor.tip: emperor 皇帝，女皇帝是 empress。

lie.tip: lie to sb 对某人撒谎；lie 也可指「躺」。

at first.tip: at first 是起初，常和 later 对应。

pretend.tip: pretend to do = 假装做某事。

artist.en: The artist drew a picture for us.
artist.cn: 这位画家为我们画了一幅画。
artist.tip: artist 是美术家、艺术家；writer 才是作家。

quickly.tip: quickly 修饰动词，放动词后面最常见。

tell the truth.tip: tell the truth 说实话，反义是 tell a lie。

all over.en: Toys are all over the floor.

make money.en: He wants to make money with his art.
make money.tip: make money 赚钱；money 不可数。

get out.en: Birds can get out of the cage.
get out.tip: get out of = 从……出来、逃出。

hopefully.tip: hopefully 放句首表示「希望如此」。

laugh at.tip: laugh at = 嘲笑；laugh 单独是「笑」。

lay.en: The hen will lay an egg.
lay.tip: lay 的过去式是 laid；lie（躺）的过去式才是 lay，别混。

swan.en: The ugly duckling grew into a swan.
swan.cn: 丑小鸭长成了一只天鹅。
swan.tip: swan 天鹅，丑小鸭故事的关键词。

go away.en: Please go away, I want to be alone.
go away.cn: 请走开，我想一个人待着。
go away.tip: go away = 走开，语气比较直接。

search for.en: They searched for the lost boy.
search for.cn: 他们寻找那个走失的男孩。
search for.tip: search for 是寻找；search 单独是「搜查」。

come out.en: The sun will come out soon.
come out.tip: come out = 出来、出现、出版。

genie.en: The genie came out of the bottle.
genie.tip: genie 妖怪、精灵，渔夫与妖怪的故事里出现。

make a promise.en: He wants to make a promise to his mother.
make a promise.tip: make a promise 许下诺言；keep a promise 是守约。

to one's surprise.en: To my surprise, he passed the exam.
to one's surprise.cn: 让我吃惊的是，他通过了考试。
to one's surprise.tip: to one's surprise = 让某人吃惊的是。

only if.en: You can go only if you finish it.
only if.tip: only if = 只有……才，条件很强。

himself.en: The emperor looked at himself in the mirror.
himself.cn: 皇帝看着镜子里的自己。
himself.tip: himself 是 he 的反身代词，主语宾语同一人时用。

Hans Christian Andersen.en: Hans Christian Andersen wrote many fairy tales.
Hans Christian Andersen.tip: 安徒生的英文全名，三个词都要大写。

instead of.en: He wore nothing instead of new clothes.
instead of.cn: 他没穿新衣服，什么也没穿。
instead of.tip: instead of = 而不是，后面跟名词或 doing。

in the end.en: In the end, the boy told the truth.
in the end.tip: in the end 强调最终结果；at the end 强调时间点。

set ...free.tip: set sb free = 释放某人，free 放最后。

succeed in doing sth.en: He succeeded in making the toy.
succeed in doing sth.cn: 他成功做出了这个玩具。
succeed in doing sth.tip: succeed in doing 成功做成某事，in 后面用 doing。

skill.en: Reading is a skill you can learn.
skill.cn: 阅读是一项可以学会的技能。

afraid.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes.
afraid.tip: be afraid of + 名词或 doing。

smile.en: She gave me a warm smile.
smile.cn: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑。
smile.tip: smile 可数：a smile；give sb a smile。

breath.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
breath.tip: breath 是名词，breathe 是动词，别混。

take one's breath away.en: The view can take your breath away.
take one's breath away.cn: 这景色能让你惊叹不已。
take one's breath away.tip: take one's breath away = 美得让人屏住呼吸。

camp.en: We camped by the lake last night.
camp.tip: camp 可作名词（营地）也可作动词（露营）。

fantastic.tip: fantastic = 极好的，口语里很常用。

ready to do sth.tip: be ready to do = 准备好做某事。

ready.tip: ready 是形容词，be ready 表示准备好了。

steamed chicken soup.en: The steamed chicken soup is delicious.
steamed chicken soup.tip: steamed 是「蒸的」，汽锅鸡是云南名菜。

Russian.tip: Russian 可指俄语、俄罗斯人、俄罗斯的。

hotel.en: We stayed in a small hotel.
hotel.tip: 住旅馆用 stay in a hotel。

remind.en: This photo reminds me of my school.
remind.cn: 这张照片让我想起我的学校。
remind.tip: remind sb of sth = 让某人想起某事。

thousands of.en: Thousands of people visit the mountain.
thousands of.cn: 成千上万的人来这座山。
thousands of.tip: thousands of 前面不加具体数字。

noon.en: We got to the top at noon.
noon.tip: at noon 在中午，noon 前面不加 the。

forget.en: Don't forget to bring your book.
forget.tip: forget to do 忘了要做；forget doing 忘了做过。

peace.en: Everyone wants peace in the world.
peace.tip: peace 不可数，指和平；peaceful 是形容词。

artwork.en: The museum has many famous artworks.
artwork.cn: 博物馆里有很多著名的艺术作品。

accordion.en: He plays the accordion very well.
accordion.tip: 乐器前加 the：play the accordion。

Sea of Clouds.en: We saw the Sea of Clouds on the top.
Sea of Clouds.cn: 我们在山顶看到了云海。
Sea of Clouds.tip: Sea of Clouds 是黄山云海的英文说法，专有名词。

Guest-Greeting Pine.tip: 迎客松在黄山，英文叫 Guest-Greeting Pine。

get together.en: The family gets together at Spring Festival.
get together.cn: 这家人在春节聚在一起。

World War II.cn: 第二次世界大战在1945年结束。
World War II.tip: World War II 读作 World War Two。

Alexander Garden.cn: 我们在亚历山大花园散步。
Alexander Garden.tip: 亚历山大花园在克里姆林宫旁边。

Moscow Metro.en: The Moscow Metro is very beautiful.
Moscow Metro.tip: metro 是地铁，Moscow Metro 是专有名词。

Nazi.tip: Nazi 纳粹，历史词，首字母大写。

the Victory Museum.en: We visited the Victory Museum in Moscow.
the Victory Museum.cn: 我们参观了莫斯科的胜利博物馆。
the Victory Museum.tip: the Victory Museum 前面必须有 the。

Red Square.en: Red Square is in the centre of Moscow.
Red Square.tip: Red Square 红场，不是「红色的广场」。

wise.en: It is wise to ask before you act.
wise.tip: wise 明智的，名词是 wisdom。

bathroom.en: The bathroom is next to my bedroom.

bedroom.en: My bedroom has a big window.
bedroom.cn: 我的卧室有一扇大窗户。
bedroom.tip: bed + room 合成词，写成一个词。

living room.en: We watch TV in the living room.
living room.tip: living room 客厅，两个词分开写。

balcony.en: There are flowers on the balcony.

sort.en: Please sort the rubbish into two bags.
sort.tip: sort 分类、整理；sort out 是整理好。

hang up.en: Hang up your coat behind the door.
hang up.tip: hang up 挂起；打电话时是「挂断」。

add sth to sth.en: Add some sugar to the milk.
add sth to sth.tip: add A to B = 把 A 加到 B 里。

add.tip: add 后面直接跟宾语，加什么就说什么。

lift.tip: lift 举起；give sb a lift 是顺路捎带。

go shopping.tip: go + doing 表示去做某事：go shopping。

give sb a lift.en: Can you give me a lift to school?
give sb a lift.cn: 你能顺路送我去学校吗？
give sb a lift.tip: give sb a lift = 开车顺便送某人。

hunt.en: They hunt for old books in the market.
hunt.cn: 他们在市场里搜寻旧书。
hunt.tip: hunt 是打猎，hunt for 是搜寻。

treasure hunt.en: The kids had a treasure hunt in the park.
treasure hunt.cn: 孩子们在公园玩了寻宝游戏。
treasure hunt.tip: treasure hunt 寻宝游戏，两个词都小写。

community.en: Our community is clean and quiet.

until.en: Wait here until I come back.
until.tip: until 直到；not ... until 是「直到……才」。

be careful with.en: Be careful with the hot water.
be careful with.tip: be careful with + 名词，小心某件东西。

the movies.en: We went to the movies last night.
the movies.tip: go to the movies 是美式说法：去看电影。

clean up.en: Let's clean up the room together.
clean up.tip: clean up = 打扫干净、收拾。

take notes.tip: take notes 做笔记，notes 要用复数。

rubbish.en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.
rubbish.tip: rubbish 不可数，英式；美式常用 trash。

share sth with sb.en: Share your toys with your sister.
share sth with sb.tip: share A with B = 和 B 分享 A。

ah.tip: ah 表示恍然大悟或惊讶。

several.en: I read several books this month.
several.cn: 这个月我读了好几本书。
several.tip: several = 好几个，后面跟可数名词复数。

familiar.en: This street looks familiar to me.
familiar.tip: be familiar to sb = 对某人来说很熟悉。

childish.en: His joke was a bit childish.
childish.tip: child + ish → childish，带点贬义「孩子气的」。

paper-cut.en: She made a paper-cut for the wall.
paper-cut.cn: 她做了一张剪纸贴在墙上。

scissors.en: Be careful, the scissors are sharp.
scissors.tip: scissors 永远是复数；a pair of scissors 才是一把。

cover.en: Cover the food with a clean cloth.
cover.cn: 用干净的布把食物盖上。
cover.tip: cover A with B = 用 B 盖住 A。

during.en: Don't play outside during the storm.
during.cn: 暴风雨期间别在外面玩。
during.tip: during + 名词，表示在某段时间里。

iron.en: The iron is too hot to touch.
iron.tip: iron 是铁器、熨斗；作动词是熨衣服。

gas.en: Turn off the gas before you leave.

carelessly.en: He carelessly left the door open.
carelessly.cn: 他粗心地把门开着就走了。

alone.en: Don't swim alone in the river.
alone.cn: 别一个人在这条河里游泳。
alone.tip: alone 是独自（客观）；lonely 是孤独（感受）。

touch.tip: touch 是触摸；keep in touch 是保持联系。

ladder.en: Don't stand on the top of the ladder.

judge.en: Don't judge a man by his clothes.
judge.cn: 不要凭衣着判断一个人。
judge.tip: judge sb by sth = 凭某物判断某人。

electrical.tip: electrical 电的；electric 多形容「用电的」。

stick.en: Don't stick your finger into the hole.
stick.tip: stick 刺、戳；作名词是枝条、棍子。

thankful.en: I am thankful for your help.
thankful.tip: be thankful for sth = 对某事心存感激。

shock.cn: 这个消息让所有人都震惊了。
shock.tip: shock 使震惊；get shocked 是触电。

outlet.en: The outlet is near the window.
outlet.tip: outlet 电源插座，全称 electrical outlet。

helmet.en: Wear a helmet when you ride a bike.

get shocked.en: You may get shocked if you touch it.

stone.en: Don't throw stones at the dog.
stone.tip: stone 石头，可数，复数是 stones。

speed.en: The car went at a high speed.
speed.tip: at a high speed = 以高速。

hit.tip: hit 的过去式和原形一样：hit-hit-hit。

protect.tip: protect sb from sth = 保护某人免受……

bravely.cn: 他勇敢地救了那个孩子。

push.en: Don't push others in the crowd.
